svg.title: The Same Spectrum and Different Resistances
svg.desc: For G1, resistance R12=1/4 comes entirely from mode 8; for G2, R12=1/2 comes entirely from eigenspace 4. For pair 13, the contributions of eigenspaces 4 and 8 are 3/8 and 1/16 in G1, and 1/4 and 1/8 in G2: totals 7/16 and 3/8. Both Kirchhoff indices are 5/2. All values use exact rational arithmetic.

cc:Work.dc:description: For G1, resistance R12=1/4 comes entirely from mode 8; for G2, R12=1/2 comes entirely from eigenspace 4. For pair 13, the contributions of eigenspaces 4 and 8 are 3/8 and 1/16 in G1, and 1/4 and 1/8 in G2: totals 7/16 and 3/8. Both Kirchhoff indices are 5/2. All values use exact rational arithmetic.
